name: Nether Earth ZS Edition '99: the menu: menupointer
summary: The pointer sprite, the marks, the keys.

entries.name: PaintBar
entries.summary: Attribute $47 in 10 cells of row A + 9 from HL ($5800 + the column)

entries.name: DrawPointer
entries.summary: Draw the pointer sprite at the position (this LD BC's operand), shifted by x AND 7

entries.name: SavePointerBg
entries.summary: The background under the pointer into PointerBg (NOPs into the copy loop)

entries.name: SetPointerBgWay
entries.summary: A into BgSwap1 and BgSwap2, then PointerBgCopy

entries.name: RestorePointerBg
entries.summary: PointerBg back to the screen (EX DE,HL into the copy loop)

entries.name: ReadMenuKeys
entries.summary: E (and A) = the menu keys, 0 = pressed: bit 0 P, 1 O, 2 Q, 3 A, 4 SPACE

labels.name: PointerBgCopy
labels.comment: 16 bytes between the screen under the pointer and PointerBg, the way BgSwap1 / BgSwap2 say

labels.name: BgSwap1
labels.comment: NOP: screen -> PointerBg; EX DE,HL: PointerBg -> screen

labels.name: PointerSprite
labels.comment: 8 rows of mask, pixels: the arrow (src/res/menu99/pointer.png)

labels.name: PointerBg
labels.comment: the 16 screen bytes under the pointer

labels.name: SavedAttrs
labels.comment: the attributes of rows 10-15 as MenuBottom found them (192 bytes)

labels.name: TextStart
labels.comment: 0, CR, LF: the stop in front of TextBuffer for the viewer's Q
